التفتن (form VIII)

# اِلْتَفَتْنَ (iltafatna) /il.ta.fat.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِلْتَفَتَ (iltafata)
# اِلْتَفِتْنَ (iltafitna) /il.ta.fit.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِلْتَفَتَ (iltafata)
